_comment: Copy to <project>/.claude/refs/mocap-smoothing.config.json and edit. Project-specific values only; nothing here belongs in the skill itself.

capture._comment_fps: The capture's native rate. The filter cutoff is specified in Hz, so this matters.

assets._comment: Filter the SOURCE skeleton, then retarget. The retargeted skeleton is mostly derived rig.

cache._comment: Originals are cached here on first apply so re-applying never compounds. Keep out of version control; regenerable by reimporting the source FBX.

defaults._comment: Values are on Rokoko's slider scale: 0.5 to 10, higher is smoother. Cutoff in Hz = 10.5 - value. Per region: 0 = inherit full_body, -1 = off (exempt from smoothing entirely).
defaults._comment_body: The defaults below ARE Rokoko's 'Body' group: master everywhere, fingers exempt. Set fingers to 0 for 'Full Body'. fingers = -1 is NOT the same as hands = -1 -- the latter leaves the wrist unfiltered too.

per_take_overrides._comment: Optional. Key by asset name. Omit entirely if every take uses the defaults.

EXAMPLE_take_name.note: Coil Pro finger jitter on this take; Gaussian avoids the ring on the hand taps.
